thread.title: Reuters: Apple eyed Samsung, MediaTek for 2019 iPhone modems - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Jason Aycock
title: Reuters: Apple eyed Samsung, MediaTek for 2019 iPhone modems - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Apple ( AAPL -1.1% ) had considered adding smartphone rival Samsung ( OTC:SSNLF ) and MediaTek to supply modem chips for 2019 iPhones , along with existing vendor Intel ( INTC +0.4% ), Reuters reports.
That comes from testimony from Apple supply chain executive Tony Blevins, testifying at the trial between Qualcomm ( QCOM +1.4% ) and the FTC.
Apple used to get such chips exclusively from Qualcomm before splitting the business with Intel in 2016.
Apple had moved solely to Intel last year for its new iPhones.
